patthana21.50:1.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ nasāsavaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana21.50:2.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ naanāsavaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana21.50:4.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ naanāsavaṃ naanidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
